server.note: Dev server: npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort, started from D:/personal/Photo/composition; it bound http://localhost:5173/. Second server for AC-8.23 only: npx vite preview on port 5175 (doctor.mjs port --extra 1, extra_ports [5175]), started from D:/personal/Photo/composition, serving a production build made with npx vite build --outDir into the session scratchpad (pwa-dist), not into the repo. Both stopped with TaskStop and doctor.mjs stop; free_after true for both ports. All checks were driven in fresh Playwright browser contexts created from the MCP browser; the MCP default context (which holds an older album) was only read, never written.

deviations.what: The Chromium File System Access save and open pickers are browser chrome and cannot be driven. An init script removed showSaveFilePicker and showOpenFilePicker, so Зберегти у файл made a download and Відкрити файл used <input type=file>.
deviations.why: Both paths carry the same bytes through serializeLayout and parseLayout in src/storage/layoutFile.ts; the phase risk (open into an empty browser, grey boxes) is downstream of the file read.

deviations.what: Same picker substitution as AC-8.16 for the save and the open of the duplicate-name layout file.
deviations.why: The check discriminates on the relink match (matchPhotos), which reads the same parsed album either way.

deviations.what: The editor's Відкрити файл was driven through <input type=file> instead of showOpenFilePicker.
deviations.why: The replace question comes after parseLayout, on the same album id, for both paths.

deviations.what: The save to file in the given used the download fallback instead of showSaveFilePicker.
deviations.why: saveLayoutFile returns Date.now() after either path, and the backup rule reads only that time and the edit time.

deviations.what: Chromium with an iPhone Safari user agent, isMobile and hasTouch replaced the WebKit mobile-webkit browser, which the MCP browser cannot launch.
deviations.why: isIos() and isStandalone() in src/ui/Banners.tsx read navigator.userAgent, maxTouchPoints, display-mode and navigator.standalone, and the closed state is in localStorage; the engine is not the layer the rule depends on.
